problemsFixed: Facts invented: 'rebooted peace talks', 'diplomatic talks resume', 'ongoing diplomatic process', 'ongoing conflict since 2022' — none of these appear in the sources. Sources only mention ships being targeted in Baltic and Mediterranean. No war dead exchange, no peace talks, no diplomatic process mentioned.
